item.title: Open Innovations in Image and Signal Processing Approaches for Emerging Business Markets
item.content:encoded:
Aceng Sambas, Universitas Muhammadiyah Tasikmalaya Indonesia

Sundarapandian Vaidyanathan, Vel Tech University India

Irene Moroz, University of Oxford

This special issue focuses on the role of image and signal processing in advancing technology for emerging business markets. As businesses face rapid transformation due to increased competition and technological evolution, image and signal processing have become essential tools for innovation. The issue seeks to explore how these technologies can extend product innovation capabilities and address the opportunities and challenges they present in this changing landscape.

Appel publié par Expert Systems. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
